product_one_liner.value: Doxis is an AI-first enterprise content-management and intelligent-content-automation platform that helps organizations manage, understand, search, and automate documents and business processes.

pricing_page.notes: The public site presents demo/contact-based purchasing and does not expose a public pricing page in its navigation.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile reports 353 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index is a marketing/product-insights blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: The public Doxis AI.dp documentation includes platform guides and an API reference with endpoint schemas and examples.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is for Full Stack AI Engineers and explicitly covers machine learning, computer vision, and LLM-based AI systems.

model_provider.notes: The company describes a composable approach using different AI models but does not publicly name a specific model provider.

last_funding.notes: The announcement does not disclose the investment amount in USD.

raised_18mo.notes: The cited most recent identified investment was announced in March 2024, outside the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open-positions list includes other sales roles, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive; Account Manager is excluded by the requested rule.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 17, 2026 announcement introduced Ask Doxi, Agent Manager, and enhanced Superhuman Search, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement says Andy Spence joined as Chief Revenue Officer and Jean Van Vuuren joined as Vice President of Sales EMEA; it also identifies Yeelen Knegtering as Chief AI Officer.
